title: Mayor
statement: The West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund is in committee this week — and I'm watching. This $4.2M program is legal defense as housing stability. Oakland funds both. The Housing and Community Development Committee has the analysis they asked for. I expect them to move it. West Oakland families facing eviction deserve more than process — they deserve representation. My office is ready to implement the day council sends it forward.

payload.text: The Oakland Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline enrollment event is scheduled. My team is finalizing venue and partner coordination with the Building Trades Council. Certification of operational rollout follows the enrollment event — we're sequencing this properly, not rushing the foundation.
